nodes.label: __main__.main
nodes.desc: Enables python -m wheel; sys.path fixup for zipapp-style runs

nodes.label: commands.main
nodes.desc: Parses argv, calls the chosen subcommand, turns WheelError into exit code 1

nodes.label: parser()
nodes.desc: Registers unpack, pack, convert, tags, info, version, help subparsers

nodes.label: unpack()
nodes.desc: Extracts wheel to {dest}/{name}-{ver} and chmods from external_attr >> 16

nodes.label: pack()
nodes.desc: Finds the single .dist-info dir, applies build/local version, repacks

nodes.label: compute_tagline()
nodes.desc: Sorted-union of impl/abi/platform tag sets joined with dots and dashes

nodes.label: tags()
nodes.desc: Verifies filename tags vs WHEEL headers, then copies entries to a renamed wheel

nodes.label: _strip_zip64_extra()
nodes.desc: Drops ZIP64 extra fields from local headers so zipfile can regenerate them

nodes.label: info()
nodes.desc: Prints name, version, tags, generator, metadata summary and file stats

nodes.label: convert()
nodes.desc: EggFileSource/WininstFileSource converters emit new wheels from legacy formats

nodes.label: bdist_wheel shim
nodes.desc: FutureWarning + re-export from setuptools.command.bdist_wheel with fallback import

nodes.label: class bdist_wheel
nodes.desc: setuptools Command with user_options for plat-name, universal, compression, py-limited-api

nodes.label: finalize_options()
nodes.desc: Sets root_is_pure from has_ext_modules/has_c_libraries, validates compression and build tag

nodes.label: run()
nodes.desc: Runs build+install into bdist_dir with .data scheme, then dist-info and archive

nodes.label: get_tag()
nodes.desc: Chooses (python, abi, platform) tag triple; 'any' when pure, asserts against sys_tags

nodes.label: get_abi_tag()
nodes.desc: Derives ABI tag from SOABI or emulates it for PyPy/debug/malloc variants

nodes.label: get_platform()
nodes.desc: sysconfig platform with macOS recalculation and 32-bit linux fixes

nodes.label: write_wheelfile()
nodes.desc: Emits .dist-info/WHEEL: Wheel-Version 1.0, Generator, Root-Is-Purelib, Tag lines

nodes.label: egg2dist()
nodes.desc: Copies .egg-info into .dist-info, writes METADATA, drops useless egg files

nodes.label: WHEEL_INFO_RE
nodes.desc: Regex parsing name-version-build-pyver-abi-plat.whl filenames

nodes.label: class WheelFile
nodes.desc: ZipFile subclass validating every read against RECORD SHA-256 hashes

nodes.label: RECORD parsing
nodes.desc: csv-parses RECORD in read mode; rejects md5/sha1 as weak per PEP 427

nodes.label: open() hash check
nodes.desc: Monkey-patches _update_crc to hash-verify each entry while streaming

nodes.label: write_files()
nodes.desc: Walks the tree sorted and defers .dist-info entries so RECORD lands last

nodes.label: writestr()
nodes.desc: Writes entry, records its sha256 digest and size for RECORD

nodes.label: close() writes RECORD
nodes.desc: Serializes path,hash,size rows; RECORD's own row keeps empty hash and size

nodes.label: SOURCE_DATE_EPOCH
nodes.desc: Clamps ZipInfo timestamps to 1980 floor and SOURCE_DATE_EPOCH for reproducible builds

nodes.label: pkginfo_to_metadata()
nodes.desc: Upgrades PKG-INFO to Metadata-Version 2.1, regenerates Requires-Dist from requires.txt

nodes.label: generate_requirements()
nodes.desc: Turns extras_require dicts into Provides-Extra / Requires-Dist pairs

nodes.label: split_sections()
nodes.desc: Splits requires.txt into (extra, lines) section pairs

nodes.label: calculate_macosx_platform_tag()
nodes.desc: Scans bundled binaries and lowers macosx_X_Y to the strictest deployment target

nodes.label: read_mach_header()
nodes.desc: Reads magic 0xCAFEBABE fat headers and LC_VERSION_MIN / LC_BUILD_VERSION load commands
